title: Usd: a digital dollar
intro: One coin = one real dollar in the bank. The issuer can only make new coins when there's cash to back them, and you can always swap coins back for dollars.
steps: Start it: give it a name, and pick who the issuer (the 'bank') is. Alice is a good choice.
As the issuer, use "Cash in the bank" to say how many dollars you hold, e.g. 1000.
Still as the issuer, "Make new coins" for someone, e.g. 100 for bob. Try making more than the bank holds: it refuses.
Switch to bob at the top right. Send some coins to carol, or cash some out.
Watch "Is every coin backed?" stay Yes the whole time.

redeem.label: Cash out
redeem.help: Your coins are burned and the bank pays you the same in dollars.

set_reserves.label: Cash in the bank (issuer only)
set_reserves.help: The issuer says how many dollars it really holds.

mint.label: Make new coins (issuer only)
mint.help: Only works if the bank holds enough dollars to cover them.

constructor.help: Name your dollar and choose who runs the bank.
